svg.title: Designed variation SG-08
svg.desc: इकारान्त / उकारान्त | Relation: पञ्चमी–षष्ठी एकवचनम् | वैदिक: can use the same -एः / -ओः pattern as masculine and feminine words; -यः / | -वः also occur | लौकिक: requires -इनः / -उनः | Contribution: open · Evidence: form recorded · question open | Prevalence: >92.1% (70/76 lexemes) · grade B
